heading: Open the Gate 4 Kane Drawer and verify initial GREEN proof + clean DevTools

flows:
Navigate to https://bevowoved.github.io/refit/?demo=1&at=100 then wait for the refit HUD cards and top status bar to render.
Click the "Gate 4 Â· Kane" button in the top status bar (perform the real click â€” never pass by reading button text alone).
Store the displayed verdict badge text as 'initial_verdict'.
Verify the drawer opens and displays "PASSED", the Antigravity MCP budget "12 / 100 cap", and the README Truth matrix showing "TRUE" entries.
Verify there are zero browser console errors and no failed 4xx or 5xx document/script requests.
